name: Scourge of the Downs
summary: Belnistrasz asks for your aid and gives you an Oathstone. You can agree and return it to him.

faq.answer: Belnistrasz asks you to aid him.

faq.q: What do I do with the Oathstone?
faq.answer: If you agree to help Belnistrasz, speak with him again and return the Oathstone.

attribution: In-game quest text: Scourge of the Downs
